activities.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (The Met)
activities.hours: Sun, Mon, Tue & Thu 10:00 AM–5:00 PM; Extended Fri & Sat 10:00 AM–9:00 PM
activities.seasonalAlert: OPEN Presidents' Day (Mon Feb 15, 2027) — expect holiday crowds. Closed Wednesdays year-round.
activities.costBasis: 2 non-NY adults general admission verified on metmuseum.org (includes same-day Met Cloisters entry)
activities.transitFromMidtown: 4/5/6 to 86th St (12–15 min) + 10 min walk · or M1/M2/M3/M4 Fifth Ave bus
activities.bookingTip: Go Friday or Saturday evening (5–9 PM) for dramatic Temple of Dendur sunset lighting and date-night live music/cocktails in the Great Hall.

reviewLinks.label: Exploring The Met Museum in 2 Hours

activities.name: The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA)
activities.hours: Daily 10:30 AM–5:30 PM; Extended Fridays 10:30 AM–8:30 PM
activities.seasonalAlert: Open 7 days a week all Feb–Mar 2027 (only closed Thanksgiving & Christmas).
activities.costBasis: 2 adults general admission (includes all galleries & special exhibitions; MoMA PS1 in Queens is FREE for all)
activities.transitFromMidtown: E/M 5th Ave–53rd St (1 min) · B/D/F/M 47–50th Sts (4 min)
activities.bookingTip: Literally connected to The Modern (2★ Michelin)! Do Floor 5 (Van Gogh Starry Night, Monet, Warhol) at 10:30 AM opening, then walk into The Modern for lunch.

activities.name: American Museum of Natural History (AMNH)
activities.address: 200 Central Park West, New York, NY 10024
activities.seasonalAlert: Tickets already live through June 30, 2027! Note 2026–27 standard out-of-state adult price increase to $37/pp.
activities.costBasis: 2 out-of-state adults verified on amnh.org ($37 General, $43 +1 show/planetarium, $48 All; NY State residents pay-what-you-wish for General)
activities.transitFromMidtown: B/C directly to 81st St–Museum of Natural History (10 min) · 1 to 79th St
activities.bookingTip: Don't miss the dramatic Richard Gilder Center canyon atrium, Blue Whale Hall, and Dinosaur Halls — perfect cozy indoor plan on a freezing winter day.

activities.name: SUMMIT One Vanderbilt
activities.hours: Daily 9:00 AM–12:00 AM (last entry 10:30 PM; select days open 8:00 AM)
activities.seasonalAlert: Indoor climate-controlled 3-level mirrored sky art — arguably NYC's #1 winter-proof observation deck!
activities.costBasis: 2 adults incl. $3/order online processing fee verified on summitov.com (Experience from $44/pp, Ascent from $63–$66/pp, Ultimate from $77–$80/pp; dynamic sunset surcharge extra)
activities.transitFromMidtown: Direct underground passage from Grand Central Terminal (4/5/6/7/S)
activities.bookingTip: Wear pants (mirrored floors!) and bring sunglasses on bright winter mornings. First morning slot (9 AM) is dramatically quieter than sunset.

reviewLinks.label: Top of the Rock vs SUMMIT Comparison

activities.name: Top of the Rock Observation Deck
activities.address: 50 W 50th St (30 Rockefeller Plaza), New York, NY 10112
activities.seasonalAlert: 67th floor has sheltered glass panels for cold/windy winter days; 70th floor is open-air 360°.
activities.costBasis: 2 adults verified on rockefellercenter.com ($42–$71/adult dynamic pricing depending on daytime vs. sunset slot; excl. tax)
activities.bookingTip: The ONLY classic Midtown deck giving you unobstructed Central Park views to the north AND the Empire State Building front-and-center to the south.

reviewLinks.label: Why Top of the Rock Wins for Views (2025)
Top of the Rock Honest Review

activities.name: Empire State Building (86th Floor Observatory)
activities.hours: Daily 10:00 AM–10:00 PM (seasonal hours vary; doors close 9:00 PM — verify day-of)
activities.seasonalAlert: ACTIVE BLACK FRIDAY DEAL (through Nov 30, 2026): $46 Flex Anytime Ticket valid ANY day for 365 days — covers all of Feb–Mar 2027!
activities.costBasis: 2 adults incl. $2/ticket booking charge verified on esbnyc.com ($46/pp 86th Fl, $81/pp 86th+102nd Fl; excl. tax)
activities.bookingTip: Every ticket includes 9 indoor museum galleries (great for warming up!) plus outdoor heaters on the 86th-floor deck.

reviewLinks.label: Empire State vs Top of the Rock Debate

activities.name: Edge at Hudson Yards
activities.hours: Daily 9:00 AM–10:00 PM (winter hours occasionally 10:00 AM–9:00 PM; last entry 1 hr prior)
activities.seasonalAlert: Book 14+ days ahead for Advance Saver ($34/pp vs $42/pp)! Outdoor triangular sky deck can be windy in Feb — dress warm.
activities.costBasis: 2 adults incl. $2/ticket processing fee verified on edgenyc.com ($34 Advance Saver, $42 Standard, $73 Flex per adult; excl. tax)
activities.transitFromMidtown: 7 train to 34th St–Hudson Yards (1 min walk) · A/C/E 34th St–Penn Station (10 min walk)
activities.bookingTip: Cheapest major NYC observatory when booked 14+ days in advance ($72/couple!), and ends right at the northern entrance of The High Line.

reviewLinks.label: Edge NYC vs SUMMIT Day & Night Review

activities.name: 9/11 Memorial & Museum
activities.hours: Outdoor Memorial Plazas: Daily 8:00 AM–8:00 PM (FREE); Museum: Wed–Mon 9:00 AM–7:00 PM (closed most Tuesdays, select holiday Tues open)
activities.seasonalAlert: Outdoor reflecting pools are FREE daily; Museum is open Presidents' Day Mon Feb 15, 2027 (verify if Tue Feb 16 has special hours).
activities.costBasis: Memorial plazas free; Museum Adult General Admission $36/adult ($72 for 2 verified on 911memorial.org; $24–$36 tiered range)
activities.transitFromMidtown: E World Trade Center · 1 WTC Cortlandt · 2/3/4/5/A/C/J/Z Fulton St (4 min walk from Artezen!)
activities.bookingTip: Deeply moving, completely underground (warm in winter!), and right beside Calatrava's Oculus transit hall and Artezen Hotel.

activities.name: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island (Statue City Cruises)
activities.address: Castle Clinton, Battery Park, New York, NY 10004
activities.hours: Daily 8:30 AM–5:00 PM (Winter schedule Jan 1 – May 22: last ferry departs Battery Park at 3:30 PM)
activities.seasonalAlert: Winter last ferry is 3:30 PM! Book morning slots (9:00–10:30 AM) so you have time for BOTH Liberty Island AND Ellis Island Immigration Museum.
activities.costDisplay: $52.00 (General Admission) · $52.60 (Pedestal or Crown Reserve — Taxes & Fees INCLUDED!)
activities.costBasis: 2 adults all-in verified on Statue City Cruises ($26.00 GA / $26.30 Pedestal or Crown incl. ferry, audio tours & both museums — ONLY authorized vendor!)
activities.transitFromMidtown: 1 South Ferry · 4/5 Bowling Green · R/W Whitehall St (18 min from Midtown; 8 min walk from Artezen)
activities.bookingTip: SCAM WARNING: Ignore aggressive ticket touts in vests outside Battery Park — ONLY buy from Statue City Cruises online or inside Castle Clinton. Crown tickets cost just $0.30 extra and sell out months ahead!

reviewLinks.label: Avoid Battery Park Ticket Scams (Official Guide)

activities.name: Staten Island Ferry (Harbor Skyline Cruise)
activities.hours: Open 24 Hours / 365 Days (departs every 15–30 min; ~25 min each way)
activities.seasonalAlert: Runs 24/7 even in winter weather; heated indoor cabins + outdoor viewing decks.
activities.costBasis: Verified free public transit operated by NYC DOT (must disembark at St. George & walk right onto next return boat)
activities.transitFromMidtown: 1 South Ferry · R/W Whitehall St · 4/5 Bowling Green
activities.bookingTip: Stand on the RIGHT side outbound to Staten Island for postcard Statue of Liberty photos, then stay outside on the return for illuminated Lower Manhattan skyline at dusk!

activities.name: Bank of America Winter Village at Bryant Park
activities.address: Bryant Park, 42nd St & 6th Ave, New York, NY 10018
activities.seasonalAlert: DEADLINE ALERT: The Rink & The Lodge close permanently for the season after Sun Feb 28, 2027! Only visits in Feb 15–28 catch it.
activities.costDisplay: $0 (Bring own skates / Free admission!) · $37.44–$128.96 (2 Skate Rentals off-peak to peak)
activities.costBasis: Verified on bryantpark.org (admission free; skate rentals $18.72–$64.48/person incl. admin fee, excl. tax; 10% off with Bank of America card)
activities.duration: 1.5–2 hours (skate + hot chocolate/cocktails at The Lodge)
activities.bookingTip: Book a weekday morning slot (8–11 AM) for the lowest ~$18.72 skate rental tier and uncrowded ice right below the skyscrapers, then warm up at The Lodge!

activities.name: Central Park & Wollman Rink Ice Skating
activities.address: 830 5th Ave (enter 59th St & 6th Ave), New York, NY 10065
activities.hours: Central Park: Daily 6:00 AM–1:00 AM (FREE); Wollman Rink (Oct 28, 2026 – Mar 16, 2027): Mon–Tue 10:00 AM–2:30 PM, Wed–Thu & Sun 10:00 AM–9:00 PM, Fri–Sat 10:00 AM–10:00 PM
closedDays: Wollman Rink CLOSED from March 17, 2027 onward
activities.seasonalAlert: BONUS: Sun Mar 14 – Tue Mar 16, 2027 are FREE End-of-Season Community Days (everyone welcome — just pay $12 skate rental)! Mon Feb 15–Sun Feb 21 are Peak days; Feb 22–25 & Mar 1–13 are Off-Peak ($16!).
activities.costDisplay: $0 (Central Park walk) · $56 (Off-Peak Skate+Rentals for 2) · $80 (Peak Skate+Rentals for 2)
activities.costBasis: Verified tax-inclusive on wollmanrinknyc.com (Off-Peak $16 + $12 rental = $28/pp; Peak $28 + $12 = $40/pp; Mar 14–16 free admission + $12 rental = $24/2; locker $8)
activities.transitFromMidtown: N/R/W 5th Ave–59th St · F 57th St · A/B/C/D/1 Columbus Circle
activities.duration: 2–3 hours (combine with Gapstow Bridge, The Mall, Bethesda Terrace & Bow Bridge)
activities.bookingTip: Feb 22–25 & Mar 1–13 save $24 per couple over Presidents' Day week! Sign the digital waiver online beforehand to skip lines.

activities.name: The High Line & Chelsea Market
activities.address: Gansevoort St to W 34th St (Chelsea Market: 75 9th Ave, NY 10011)
activities.hours: High Line Winter Hours (Dec 1 – Mar 31): Daily 7:00 AM–7:00 PM; Chelsea Market Concourse: Daily 7:00 AM–10:00 PM
activities.seasonalAlert: Winter hours close the High Line at 7:00 PM (until Mar 31); free docent walking tours run Wed 10 AM & Sat 12 PM (Nov–Apr).
activities.costDisplay: $0 (Admission free; budget $30–$50 for Los Tacos No. 1 / Chelsea Market bites)
activities.costBasis: High Line park & Chelsea Market entry 100% free (verified on thehighline.org & chelseamarket.com)
activities.bookingTip: Start at 34th St/Hudson Yards (after Edge), walk south along the High Line admiring winter grasses & architecture, then duck inside warm Chelsea Market for tacos & pastries!

reviewLinks.label: Chelsea Market, High Line & Hudson Yards 4K Walk

activities.name: Brooklyn Bridge Walk & DUMBO / Brooklyn Bridge Park
activities.address: Brooklyn Bridge Pedestrian Promenade → Washington St & Brooklyn Bridge Park, BK
activities.hours: Brooklyn Bridge Promenade: Open 24/7; Brooklyn Bridge Park: Daily 6:00 AM–1:00 AM (Winter restrooms 7:00 AM–10:00 PM)
activities.seasonalAlert: Dress for brisk East River wind in Feb/Mar; warm up indoors at Time Out Market DUMBO right on the waterfront.
activities.costDisplay: $0 (100% FREE iconic NYC walk & skyline views)
activities.transitFromMidtown: 4/5/6 Brooklyn Bridge–City Hall (Manhattan side) · Return via F York St, A/C High St, or NYC Ferry ($4.50)
activities.bookingTip: Walk from Brooklyn TO Manhattan (or early morning before 9 AM) so you face the jaw-dropping Lower Manhattan skyline the whole way across!

reviewLinks.label: Time Out Market DUMBO Rooftop Views

activities.name: Broadway Show via Official TKTS Discount Booth (by TDF)
activities.neighborhood: Times Square / Theater District (or Lincoln Center)
activities.address: Father Duffy Square (Broadway & W 47th St) · Lincoln Center (61 W 62nd St)
activities.hours: TKTS Times Square: Mon/Tue/Thu 3:00–8:00 PM, Wed/Fri/Sat 11:00 AM–8:00 PM, Sun 11:00 AM–7:00 PM (Lincoln Center: Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat 11 AM–6 PM; closed Sun/Mon/Thu)
closedDays: Most Broadway shows are dark Mondays!
activities.seasonalAlert: Feb & early Mar are peak Broadway discount season — TKTS routinely offers 30%–50% off top musicals & plays (note $7/ticket TDF fee).
activities.costDisplay: $120–$260 (2 Same-Day TKTS Discount Seats; Digital Rush/Lottery ~$90 for 2)
activities.costBasis: 2 adults estimated via official TDF TKTS 20%–50% off board (exact show prices vary daily on tdf.org/tkts-live; full-price Broadway averages $74–$298/seat)
activities.transitFromMidtown: N/Q/R/W/1/2/3/7/S Times Square–42nd St (2–4 min walk)
activities.duration: 2.5–3 hours (evening 7–8 PM or Wed/Sat/Sun 2–3 PM matinee)
activities.bookingTip: Insider hack: Skip the long Times Square queue and hit TKTS Lincoln Center (Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat) for almost identical inventory in 10 minutes — plus it sells next-day matinees!

reviewLinks.label: Official TKTS Times Square Hours & Tips

activities.name: Dizzy's Club (Jazz at Lincoln Center)
activities.address: 10 Columbus Circle (Broadway & 60th St), 5th Fl, New York, NY 10019
activities.hours: Mon–Sat sets at 7:00 PM & 9:00 PM (doors 6:00 / 8:30 PM); Sun 5:00 PM & 7:30 PM; Late Night Sessions Thu–Sat 10:45 PM
activities.seasonalAlert: Book Valentine's week sets early; regular Feb/Mar weeknight sets are effortless to reserve 2–3 weeks out.
activities.costDisplay: $30 (Thu–Sat 10:45 PM Late Night) · $70–$110 (Main Sets cover; excl. food/drink min)
activities.costBasis: 2 adults music cover verified on jazz.org ($20–$55/pp tiered cover; $15/pp Thu–Sat 10:45 PM Late Night Session; food/beverage separate)
activities.transitFromMidtown: A/B/C/D/1 59th St–Columbus Circle (direct indoor elevator inside Deutsche Bank Center)
activities.bookingTip: Floor-to-ceiling glass wall behind the bandstand overlooking illuminated Central Park South! Ultimate cozy winter NYC jazz date night — or pair directly after Per Se upstairs.

activities.name: Grand Central Terminal & NY Public Library (Schwarzman Building)
activities.address: Grand Central: 89 E 42nd St · NYPL: 476 Fifth Ave (at 42nd St), NY 10018
activities.hours: Grand Central: Daily 5:15 AM–2:00 AM; NYPL Schwarzman Building: Mon/Thu/Fri/Sat 10 AM–6 PM, Tue–Wed 10 AM–8 PM, Sun 1–5 PM (Rose Main Reading Room visiting hour Mon–Sat 10–11 AM)
closedDays: NYPL closed federal holidays — verify Mon Feb 15 Presidents' Day!
activities.seasonalAlert: Flagged check: NYPL typically closes on Presidents' Day (Mon Feb 15, 2027); visit Tue–Sat instead! Grand Central is open 365 days.
activities.costDisplay: $0 (100% FREE architectural icons + FREE NYPL daily tours)
activities.costBasis: Verified free entry on grandcentralterminal.com & nypl.org (Whispering Gallery, celestial ceiling, Patience & Fortitude lions, Rose Main Reading Room)
activities.transitFromMidtown: 4/5/6/7/S Grand Central–42nd St (3 min walk between both landmarks!)
activities.bookingTip: Arrive at NYPL right at 10:00 AM (Mon–Sat) for the dedicated 10–11 AM Rose Main Reading Room public visiting hour (last entry 10:50 AM), then stroll 2 blocks east to Grand Central & SUMMIT!

reviewLinks.label: How to Tour the Rose Main Reading Room (2025)

activities.name: 29th Chinatown Lunar New Year Parade & Festival (2027)
activities.address: Starts Mott St & Canal St → ends Sara D. Roosevelt Park (Grand St)
activities.hours: ONE DAY ONLY: Sunday, February 21, 2027 starting at 1:00 PM (parade & festival ~1:00–4:30 PM)
activities.seasonalAlert: TIME-SENSITIVE 2027 EVENT: Only trips overlapping Sun Feb 21, 2027 (such as Feb 15–22) experience NYC's legendary dragon/lion dance parade! (Lunar New Year Firecracker Ceremony is earlier on Feb 6.)
activities.costDisplay: $0 (FREE street parade & festival; bring cash for Chinatown dim sum/buns!)
activities.costBasis: Confirmed free public event by official organizer Better Chinatown USA
activities.transitFromMidtown: 6/N/Q/R/W/J/Z Canal St · B/D Grand St (15 min from Midtown; 10 min walk from Arlo SoHo or Artezen)
activities.bookingTip: Claim a curb spot along Mott St or Bayard St by 12:15 PM, then duck into Chinatown or Little Italy for hot soup dumplings afterward — or walk 15 min to Katz's Deli!

reviewLinks.label: NYC Chinatown Lunar New Year Parade Highlights
